lane: FOREST-ROAD (PLATE SPRINT Phase 2) — ARM-B generalization test on an UNSEEN structure class
room: forest_road (outdoor linear dirt road through forest at dusk)
recipe_under_test: flux-1-dev + ControlNet-depth base from greybox (control_strength 0.7, seed 42, no z-image LoRA) -> Gemini instruction-edit style pass (model_google-gemini-3-1-flash, referenceImages=house anchor, structure-lock prompt)
verdict: The proven ARM-B recipe does NOT generalize as written. A correct, at-parity dusk forest road IS reachable, but only via an amended path, and the automated convergence gate cannot certify it.

findings.title: referenceImages is a CONTENT anchor, not a STYLE anchor
findings.detail: Gemini style pass with referenceImages=[crypt_dense_v1] reproduced the crypt wholesale (arm_iter1_cryptref_LEAKED_crypt.jpg); swapping to camp_clearing_night_v2 reproduced the camp (arm_iter1_campref_LEAKED_camp.jpg). Two independent anchors each leaked their full room content. Masked on crypt because anchor and target were the SAME room.

findings.title: edge-recall registration is content-blind AND anti-correlated with correctness for organic rooms
findings.detail: The wrong-room crypt PASSES the >=0.95 gate; the correct best plate FAILS it. Edge-recall rewards busy imagery and penalizes faithful painterly reinterpretation of a boxy greybox into organic forest forms. Gate co-tuned on hard-edged masonry (crypt boxes ~= stone blocks); unreachable by a correct organic/outdoor plate.

findings.title: the dimetric camera pin was silently supplied by the same-room reference
findings.detail: Dropping referenceImages (needed to stop Finding-1 content-leak) also drops the camera pin: prompt-only no-ref recovered correct content but tilted to an eye-level landscape (reg 0.9817, wrong projection). Re-supplying the pin via an explicit dimetric-lock prompt clause recovered a high bird's-eye dimetric-ish view (iter2, the best candidate).

panel.read: Candidate TIES the adopted outdoor house anchor (6.0 == 6.0) on an unseen structure; control valid at 9.0.

convergence.caveat: registration miss is Finding 2 (broken gate for organic content), not a bad plate; panel 6.0 == outdoor incumbent's own bar (at-parity).

sidecar_note: forest_road_greybox_{depth,normal}.png produced headlessly (qa/greybox_sidecars_headless.py, same camera basis as greybox, no GEX44 box). ARM-B does NOT consume them: flux ControlNet derives depth server-side from the greybox controlImage, and #1481 concluded the WOSRelight lane that consumed depth/normal sidecars should STOP (shared-greybox sidecars stamped vertical-banding seams onto warm plates). Shipped for parity + a reproducible no-box sidecar path.
